test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Parts of the following sentence have been underlined and given as options. Select the option that contains an error.

__Policeman__ came to __my village__ and asked about __a person__ who burgled __a house__ last night.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**policeman**" is incorrect in this context because it should be in plural form to match the subject-verb agreement. The correct term should be "policemen". (पुलिसकर्मियों)
 
• In the given sentence, "Policeman" (singular) does not agree with the action of "came" as it implies more than one officer. Thus, "Policemen" (plural) is appropriate.
 
• Therefore, the error is located in **part 4** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"**Policemen** came to my village and asked about a person who burgled a house last night."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **my village** (मेरा गाँव) – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **a person** (एक व्यक्ति) – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **a house** (एक घर) – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
